turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Adrian. Rachel Tan speaking. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a quieter moment?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel, Adrian Lim here. In my office now, door closed already. [[EV_010]] [[EV_011]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the discussion, is there anything about the format of your portfolio updates that you would like changed?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Keep them short, can? These days I spend so much time with the business, the reading gets pushed aside. A clear summary at the front helps. The longer documents, I can keep for when I'm properly sitting down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note your preference for a concise opening summary, with the detailed material kept separate. What tends to interrupt your reading time?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Usually staff coming in with operational matters. Nothing dramatic, but once I stop reading, hard to pick up the thread again lah. Anyway, let me give you the background before we get distracted. [[EV_015]] [[EV_016]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for setting out the background. [[EV_001]] [[EV_006]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me hear the rest first. [[EV_012]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: There are further points to cover. [[EV_005]] [[EV_009]]

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Let me set out the details. [[EV_018]] [[EV_019]] [[EV_013]] [[EV_014]] [[EV_017]] [[EV_020]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before the final readback, a brief administrative point: would you prefer routine correspondence through your usual secure channel rather than a telephone conversation during office hours?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The usual secure channel is better. Phone rings when I'm talking to staff, then everything gets interrupted. I check messages myself when the office quietens down.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will note that correspondence preference. [[EV_007]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. That concludes the instruction discussion. You can contact me through the usual channel if you need help locating any correspondence.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. That saves me hunting through messages. Better get back to work now, my desk quite full already.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time. I will leave you to your work. Have a good afternoon.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: You too. Thanks for keeping the call focused. Bye.
